source_text.ISS-0917:
id: ISS-0917
title: "Catalog SERVICE_TASK cannot execute: ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2 is an unconditional {:error,:not_registered}; POST /tasks/:id/complete returns 500 when the next node is a catalog-only SERVICE_TASK"
discovered_by: RELEASE-VALIDATOR
discovered_in_run: WF02-REQ432-20260930 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-09-30T20:50:51Z"
severity: MAJOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by WF02-REQ432-20260930 (REQ-432 live pipeline run,
  test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml; step-02b-rework1-frontend-
  dev.json). A process whose SERVICE_TASK references a service_id (catalog_entry pin) cannot
  ever execute: Letflow.Engine.ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2
  (lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex ~411-416) returns {:error,:not_registered}
  unconditionally, so activation renders an empty URL. Measured live: completing the
  preceding human task hops synchronously into the SERVICE_TASK, the engine persists only
  EXECUTION_ERROR (affected node n3, error_type service_task_url_rendered_empty, no
  TASK_COMPLETED for the completed task) and POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete answers HTTP
  500 (probably needs a non-500 mapping for {:instance_execution_error,_,_} in
  lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex). Independent of service retirement. Consequence: scenario
  platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change EO-001/EO-004 'the in-flight step completes
  without error' cannot be met on success; REQ-432's pipeline spec accepts the measured
  outcome (B) as a documented limitation. Needed: resolve service_id through the instance's
  PINNED service_catalog version (Letflow.Engine.PinResolver / ServiceCatalog lookup) in the
  dispatcher, then tighten the REQ-432 spec step 03 to require success. SCOPE GAP already
  noted in design docs lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md and
  lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md (M5). Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via
  CODE-DESIGNER). Severity MAJOR.
  NOTE (added by ORCH at close-out of the cancelled duplicate run WF02-REQ432-20260930): the
  REQ-432 implementation that actually landed on main is PR #2055 (5d7ca7bf), not this run's
  branch. Its spec (web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change
  .pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, header 'Scope note (deliberately not exercised): SERVICE_TASK dispatch')
  never drives a token onto the SERVICE_TASK node, so on main the scenario's 'the in-flight step
  completes without error' (EO-001/EO-004 step 3) is unverified; the evidence of this stub's effect
  is the duplicate run's live finding (archived on remote branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930,
  handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02b-rework1-frontend-dev.json and step-05-release-validator.json).
source_reports:
  - handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-05-release-validator.json
  - test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex
queue_ref: Q-907  # queue allocated issue_ref ISS-0907, which collides with an existing local file; local filename kept as ISS-0917 (next free on origin/main) and GH-2057 retitled to match
github_ref: GH-2057
status: open

All are committed on the branch. (3) WF-03 fail-first rule: YOU MUST INDEPENDENTLY RE-RUN the pre-fix side yourself: throwaway `git worktree add` of the merge-base (git merge-base HEAD origin/main) in a sibling dir, REAL COPY of deps and _build via robocopy /E (NEVER junction/symlink), copy only the new/changed test files, run MIX_ENV=test mix test <files> and report the fail counts; AND independently APPLY at least TWO of the reported mutants (choose m1 live-row fallback and m7 router clause order or m2 tenant visibility; others optional) in a throwaway worktree of THIS branch (never in the main checkout) and report the failing counts versus TEST-DESIGNER's claims (m1 13/40, m2 4/40, m7 R2 fails). (4) Run the new test files once in the main checkout post-fix (scoped; machine memory is limited and test DB is shared with other workers, so no full suite; re-run once on tenant_template DB-collision flakiness and say so). (5) Remove worktrees at the end (`git worktree remove --force`, `git worktree prune`), verify `ls deps | wc -l` unchanged (was 29) and `git status --porcelain lib/ test/ web/` empty in the main checkout, and quote both. Verdict PASS/FAIL with numbered blocking issues. Modify only your handoff; do not commit.

result.summary: Read the design 6.1-6.4, test/specs/ISS-0917.md, the e2e spec diff and test sources directly; grepped the new files for skip/TODO/@tag/async (none; both ExUnit files `use Letflow.DataCase, async: false` with the reason stated; the 3 new router tests have no skip). Every AC-1..AC-12 and T1-T11/R1-R3/resolver matrix maps to a runnable test per the spec table; T11's failing branch is unreachable via public API and is honestly declared (control test only), escalation-timer site declared covered by T8a/T8b wrapper (design T8 allowance). PRE-FIX re-run (my own): throwaway worktree of merge-base 0b1931d3 with REAL cp -r copies of deps (29) and _build, only the 3 test files copied in, MIX_ENV=test mix test: engine+resolver files 4/40 passed = 36 failed (claim 36 of 40 confirmed; resolver 14 fail UndefinedFunctionError, engine 22 behavioural fail); routers/tasks_test.exs 73/75 passed = R1 and R2 fail, R3 passes (guard) - matches claim. Because the pre-fix failure for the resolver is 'function did not exist', mutants applied by me in a throwaway worktree of this branch, each reverted with git checkout -- lib and git status --porcelain lib test empty: m1 (live-row fallback: both locate clauses `if true`) 13 of 40 fail (27/40 passed) = exactly TEST-DESIGNER's 13/40; m1-variant (live-row fallback only when archive lookup misses) 6 of 40 fail; m2 (tenant visibility ignored, scope :tenant -> {:ok, entry}) 4 of 40 fail (36/40 passed) = claim 4/40; m7 (router instance_execution_error clause moved after catch-all; compiler warned clause cannot match) routers/tasks_test.exs 74/75 passed, only R2 fails = claim. POST-FIX in main checkout (scoped, one run, no tenant_template collision so no re-run needed): engine+resolver+routers/tasks_test+engine/service_task_dispatcher_test = 161 passed, 0 failed. E2E spec judged statically against 6.4: pinDispatchCaseId second case added to state and cleanup; long-running case untouched; v1 endpoint = base + /shared-connection/v1, v2 trap built from URL(base).origin + trap path; jwtSubject import and adminSub stored; HUMAN_TASK attrs {role: adminSub, assignee_type 'USER', assignee_ref: adminSub}; step 04b placed between 04 and 05 asserting 200, ACTIVE, no EXECUTION_ERROR, TASK_COMPLETED, bounded 120s COMPLETED poll enforced by default, skip only on E2E_SKIP_SERVICE_TASK_POLL=1 with console.warn + skipped-assertion annotation; header Scope note replaced. Cleanup: both worktrees removed with git worktree remove --force + prune (git worktree list shows only main checkout, no *-tdv-* sibling dirs); ls deps | wc -l = 29 (unchanged); git status --porcelain lib/ test/ web/ = empty (only pre-existing untracked letflow-3.code-workspace outside those paths). No tests rewritten, nothing committed.
